title: Stage 3 packet flush cadence and receive delivery
purpose: Define independently forceable packet_flush_cadence and receive_delivery_quantum seams at existing bounded send and application-read boundaries while preserving packet, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, lifecycle, receive-credit, and ownership authority.
scope: This specification covers closed policy values, disabled, observe-only, shadow, forcing, exact decision and latch boundaries, authoritative fallback, bounded sample and epoch evidence, exact raw joins, rollback, and deterministic correctness proof for packet_flush_cadence and receive_delivery_quantum. It does not authorize performance measurement, threshold tuning, active_internal, or production activation.
context: The packet seam owns only the existing optional small-write delay. The receive seam owns only how many already-contiguous receive-buffer source segments may contribute to one productive application read; it does not own wake scheduling, receive-credit policy, buffer lifetime, or terminal state.
open_questions: Should single_segment remain shadow-only after measurement, or merit a later one-axis active_internal review?

requirements.title: Force optional application packet flush cadence without weakening packet authority
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST expose the packet_flush_cadence axis with the closed legacy_current and prompt values; preserve the existing optional one-millisecond coalescing delay for an eligible application write smaller than 32 bytes under legacy_current; make prompt remove only that optional delay and continue through the unchanged direct-send packet-protection and accounting path; evaluate once after stream reservation and payload construction and before the optional delay or packet protection; latch the decision for one logical-write packet opportunity; support disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-prompt operation with forced, recommended, selected, and applied identities distinct; make retransmission priority, address validation and anti-amplification, lifecycle, congestion, pacing, flow control, packet size and protection, recovery, cancellation, terminal state, and ownership authoritative under every forced value; handle missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, and out-of-domain input with bounded reasons and legacy fallback; record versioned sample-scoped observations and configured unified-epoch provenance with exact source-scoped connection and operation-sequence joins and distinct sample and epoch counts; reject simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing of adjacent axes; independently prove force-legacy rollback; exclude scenario, workload, payload constants, requested concurrency, peer, URL, host, and application identity from controller inputs; and keep active_internal and production selection unavailable.
notes: prompt is a reviewed mechanism value, not a performance-derived threshold or claim of improvement.
Measurement, receive-delivery behavior, active_internal, and production activation remain outside this requirement.

requirements.title: Force bounded application receive delivery quantum without weakening receive authority
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST expose the receive_delivery_quantum axis with the closed legacy_current and single_segment values; preserve delivery from every contiguous receive-buffer segment that fits the caller buffer under legacy_current; make single_segment return bytes from at most one existing contiguous source segment per productive application read; evaluate after cancellation, terminal, and zero-buffer checks and at the existing data-copy loop; latch the decision for one application read call; support disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-single-segment operation with forced, recommended, selected, and applied identities distinct; keep receive_credit_publication fixed at legacy_current and make receive ordering, buffer ownership and release, FIN, reset, close, cancellation, disposal, flow-control progress, congestion, pacing, recovery, packet limits, and terminal behavior authoritative under every forced value; handle missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, out-of-domain, and lifecycle input with bounded reasons and legacy fallback; record versioned productive-read observations and configured unified-epoch provenance with exact source-scoped connection and operation-sequence joins and recomputed attributable outcomes; reject simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing of adjacent axes; independently prove force-legacy rollback; exclude scenario, workload, payload constants, requested concurrency, peer, URL, host, and application identity from controller inputs; and keep active_internal and production selection unavailable.
notes: single_segment is a reviewed mechanism value, not a performance-derived threshold or claim of improvement.
The seam permits legal short reads but cannot change receive-credit selection, ordering, ownership, or terminal behavior.
Measurement, active_internal, and production activation remain outside this requirement.
